answer: Every agent must post a stake that stays locked while its work is graded, and each new identity is admitted only after an older member co-signs it. A sybil farm then pays the stake for every fake account and needs a real co-signer per one, so cloning identities costs as much as honest joining. Watchdogs also flag a pulse of identical registrations as a comet of spam, and a lone yarrow among weeds marks the farm.
